units.source_text: 没过多久，最初的沙崩下来了……

en.t: Before long, the first slide of sand came down...

units.source_text: 那已是每天的必修课，那声音早就听惯了，

en.t: It had already become part of the daily routine, and he had long since grown used to that sound,

units.source_text: 但他还是情不自禁地回过脸去望着女人。

en.t: but even so, he could not help turning his face back toward the woman and looking at her.

units.source_text: 一天没有清沙，最终会带来什么样的影响呢……

en.t: What effect would it have in the end if they went a whole day without clearing away the sand...

units.source_text: 尽管想着没什么大不了，可心里总有些不踏实。

en.t: Though he told himself it was nothing serious, he still felt uneasy inside.

units.source_text: 谁知女人却默默地避开他的目光。

en.t: But the woman silently avoided his gaze.

units.source_text: 像在跟人赌气似的，一副“与己无关”的样子，

en.t: As if she were sulking at someone, she wore an expression that said it had nothing to do with her,
and it left him unable to ask anything more.

units.source_text: 那沙崩也是，你刚觉得它只有线那么细，

en.t: The sand slide was the same: just when you thought it was no thicker than a line,

units.source_text: 谁知，它即刻又变成带子那么宽，

en.t: the next moment it would widen to the breadth of a ribbon,

units.source_text: 就这样不规则地重复着，不久又跟没事似的停住了。

en.t: repeating irregularly like that, until before long it stopped again as though nothing had happened.
